protocol.target_detail: forward realized return variance = m2 = mean((r - mean(r))**2) over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); the symmetric second central moment -- the m2 term of the sealed EVAL-138 moment family, reported on its own
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_tox_z_k, own_var_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher other-asset order-flow toxicity -> higher forward realized return variance on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
